t: Deta TTE Maxi trunking end caps provide a neat and secure finish for electrical cable management systems. Manufactured from high impact, robust heavy gauge uPVC, they offer durability and protection for cables. Ideal for electricians installing new wiring in commercial or domestic properties, these 16mm x 16mm end caps ensure a professional appearance. The white uPVC construction blends seamlessly with existing trunking, providing a reliable and long-lasting solution for cable termination. They are suitable for both left and right-handed applications, offering versatility during installation.
